wiki.title: Joseph Gullett
wiki.extract: Joseph Brian Gullett (born March 27, 1980) is an American politician who is a Georgia State Representative, currently representing the 19th District. He was elected in 2018 and was sworn into office on January 14, 2019. He currently serves as chairman of Appropriations overseeing the Judiciary, member of Governmental Affairs, member of Insurance, member of Judiciary Non-Civil, member of Banks and Banking, member of Technology and Innovation, and member of Juvenile Justice. Legislatively he focuses on holding the powerful accountable, improving the Georgia foster care system, and supporting public safety.
